title: Bounded-fanout circuit conversion
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs whose gates each have distinct arguments and exactly one argument for a NOT gate or two for an AND or OR gate. There is a circuit $C'$ on the same inputs with these same gate conditions, with fanout at most $2$ at every vertex, and computing the same Boolean function as $C$ on every input assignment, such that $C'$ has size at most $5$ times the size of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: Every gate of $C$ has distinct arguments and the prescribed arity
